lines.en: label christmastwo14:
scene sidechristmas1
: It’s been quite a while since we’ve done anything like this, hasn’t it?
lines.zh: : 我们已经很久没做过这种事了，对吧？

lines.en: : Probably about...365 days?
: They normally take Christmas trees down after Christmas is over.
lines.zh: : 圣诞节过完以后，人们一般会把圣诞树拆掉。

lines.en: : Then we should probably stop waiting until February to remove ours.
lines.zh: : 那我们大概也别再拖到二月才拆我们那棵了。

lines.en: : We’ll get to it when we get to it.
lines.zh: : 该拆的时候自然就拆了。

lines.en: : That we will, my kitten.
lines.zh: : 是呀，会拆的，我的小猫咪。

lines.en: : Hey...Wakana?
lines.zh: : 那个……Wakana？

lines.en: : Yes, my love?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，我的爱人？

lines.en: : Thanks for coming tonight...I know you don’t normally like doing things like this.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你今晚来……我知道你平时不太喜欢做这种事。

lines.en: : The list of things I actively enjoy is rather short...so if I am able to make your life the slightest bit better by staring at lights with you, I will happily blind myself.
lines.zh: : 我真心喜欢的东西清单相当短……所以如果能陪你一起盯着灯看，让你的生活好上哪怕一点点，我愿意把自己的眼睛看瞎。

lines.en: : I mean...you don’t have to go that far.
lines.zh: : 我是说……你不用做到那个地步。

lines.en: : But I would.
lines.zh: : 但我愿意。

lines.en: : There are few things in life I would not do for you, Osako.
lines.zh: : 这世上没什么事是我不会为你做的，Osako。

lines.en: : You’re...being surprisingly sentimental all of a sudden. It’s not like you.
lines.zh: : 你……突然变得出人意料地多愁善感。这不像你。

lines.en: : Indeed I am.
lines.zh: : 确实如此。

lines.en: : Perhaps this is what they call “Christmas spirit?”
lines.zh: : 也许这就是人们说的“圣诞精神”？

lines.en: : It’s quite strange how simply staring at this tree compels me to say things like this to you.
lines.zh: : 只是盯着这棵树看，就让我忍不住对你说出这种话，真是奇怪。

lines.en: : But I suppose I’m a rather compulsive woman by nature, aren’t I?
lines.zh: : 不过我想，我天生就是个相当冲动的女人，不是吗？

lines.en: : That’s a little bit of an understatement...
lines.zh: : 这话说得有点轻描淡写了……

lines.en: : It’s not like that’s a new characteristic or anything, though. I’ve known you to be that person ever since I met you and it did nothing to keep me away.
lines.zh: : 不过这也不是什么新特征。从我认识你那天起，你就是那样的人，而这也丝毫没能让我退却。

lines.en: : In fact, I kind of like that side of you sometimes. It keeps things...I don’t know, exciting?
lines.zh: : 事实上，我有时候还挺喜欢你那一面的。它让一切……我不知道，充满刺激？

lines.en: : And other times?
lines.zh: : 那其他时候呢？

lines.en: : You can be honest with me.
lines.zh: : 你可以对我说实话。

lines.en: : Hold nothing back for my sake.
lines.zh: : 不用为了我有所保留。

lines.en: : Then...
lines.zh: : 那么……

lines.en: : Other times, it’s terrifying.
lines.zh: : 其他时候，它很可怕。

lines.en: : Like, right now, everything is great. But sometimes, it feels like you’re not even living in the same world as me.
lines.zh: : 比如现在，一切都很好。但有时候，感觉你像是根本没和我活在同一个世界。

lines.en: : And you’ll do these things that I know you wouldn’t {i}choose{/i} to do if the choice was fully yours. Like...with what happened on the beach.
lines.zh: : 然后你会做出一些我知道、如果选择权完全在你手里，你绝对不会{i}选{/i}的事。比如……海滩上发生的那件事。

lines.en: : I apologize again for that.
lines.zh: : 那件事我再次向你道歉。

lines.en: : You’ve apologized probably a hundred times by now....and I’ve accepted every single one of them.
lines.zh: : 你已经道歉了大概一百次了……而每一次我都接受了。

lines.en: : But that doesn’t stop me from worrying about something like that happening again in the future.
lines.zh: : 但这并不能阻止我担心将来再发生同样的事。

lines.en: : That’s the compulsive behavior I’m really worried about. I don’t mind the small stuff like...spending too much money on clothes or...inviting your coworker over to make weird, jello soup.
lines.zh: : 我真正担心的就是那种冲动行为。那些小事我倒不在乎，比如……花太多钱买衣服，或者……把同事叫来做什么奇怪的果冻汤。

lines.en: : Perhaps you could chain me up to prevent those compulsions from showing up ever again? It might be fun experiencing how you feel all the time.
lines.zh: : 也许你可以把我用链子锁起来，好让那些冲动再也不出现？体验一下你一直以来的感受，说不定还挺有趣。

lines.en: : Not right now, please.
lines.zh: : 现在先别，拜托。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for the 101st time. But before you can accept this one as well, please let me say something.
lines.zh: : 第 101 次对不起了。不过在你接受这次道歉之前，请让我说句话。

lines.en: : You can say whatever you want. We have the entire night to ourselves.
lines.zh: : 你想说什么都行。我们有一整个晚上独处。

lines.en: : And I’d like to have many more.
lines.zh: : 而我还想要很多个这样的夜晚。

lines.en: : That’s all I wanted to say, really. Just in a lot more words than that.
lines.zh: : 其实我想说的就这些。只不过用了比这多得多的话。

lines.en: : Despite how displeased I am with the lights and sounds and crowds of people, I would not trade a moment like this for the world. And that is because you are here with me.
lines.zh: : 尽管我讨厌这些灯光、声音和人群，但这样的瞬间，给我全世界我也不换。而那是因为你在我身边。

lines.en: : I want there to be many more Christmases after this one.
lines.zh: : 我希望在这个圣诞节之后，还能有很多很多个圣诞节。

lines.en: : I want to hate these lights and sounds and crowds of people so much more.
lines.zh: : 我想更多地憎恨这些灯光、声音和人群。

lines.en: : And even if I make mistakes, the same way any other human does, I do not want them to sabotage this perpetual cycle of recycled holidays and excuses to walk beside you.
lines.zh: : 就算我犯了错——就像任何一个人都会犯的那样——我也不希望它们毁掉这个不断循环的节日，以及这些陪你走走的借口。

lines.en: : Your last mistake almost {i}killed{/i} you, Wakana.
lines.zh: : 你上一次犯错差点{i}要了你的命{/i}，Wakana。

lines.en: : And I know that’s not what you were trying to do, but it’s what happened.
lines.zh: : 我知道那不是你想做的事，但事情就是这么发生了。

lines.en: : What if I didn’t come back when I did?
lines.zh: : 如果我没有在那个时候回来呢？

lines.en: : What if I walked around for even, like...half an hour longer? Who knows if we’d even be standing here right now?
lines.zh: : 如果我再多走哪怕……半个小时？谁知道我们此刻还能不能站在这里？

lines.en: : That thought is precisely {i}why{/i} I did what I did, Osako.
lines.zh: : {i}正是{/i}这个念头，让我做了我做过的事，Osako。

lines.en: : In my eyes, as clouded as they were at the time, I felt as if I was going to die if I {i}didn’t{/i} do something.
lines.zh: : 在我当时那样浑浊的眼中，我觉得如果我{i}不{/i}做点什么，我就会死。

lines.en: : Obviously, that was not the correct decision in hindsight, but people can not be expected to think rationally when faced with fear.
lines.zh: : 事后看来，那显然不是正确的决定，但人在面对恐惧时，本来就不能指望理性思考。

lines.en: : Do you at least understand why I’ve been so...neurotic lately, then?
lines.zh: : 那你至少能理解我最近为什么这么……神经质了吗？

lines.en: : I believe the word you are searching for is “clingy,” my kitten. And yes, I do.
lines.zh: : 我想你要找的词是“黏人”，我的小猫咪。是的，我能理解。

lines.en: : I’m sorry for that, by the way. I just keep thinking that if I don’t make sure you’re okay every few minutes that you’ll...yeah.
lines.zh: : 顺便说一句，我为此道歉。我只是总在想，如果我不每隔几分钟就确认你没事，你就会……嗯。

lines.en: : It seems I have some work to do if you are to ever trust me again.
lines.zh: : 看来我要做些努力，才能让你重新信任我。

lines.en: : It’s not a trust thing, it’s...ugh. I don’t know what it is.
lines.zh: : 这不是信不信任的问题，是……唉。我不知道那是什么。

lines.en: : I really wish I was as good with words as you are sometimes.
lines.zh: : 我真希望有时候自己也能像你一样擅长言辞。

lines.en: : And I sometimes wish that I knew how to end a human’s life by tapping the correct pressure point.
lines.zh: : 而我有时候希望自己知道该按哪个压力点才能了结一个人类的性命。

lines.en: : Besides, I do not mind your clinginess at all. I find it rather endearing, actually.
lines.zh: : 再说，我一点也不介意你的黏人。事实上，我觉得那相当惹人疼。

lines.en: : Why else would I have not complained about it even once since college?
lines.zh: : 不然我从大学起一次都没抱怨过，是为什么？

lines.en: : I don’t know, it’s...
lines.zh: : 我不知道，就是……

lines.en: : I just...wish I could protect you a little better.
lines.zh: : 我只是……希望能更好地保护你一点。

lines.en: : I just don’t really know how to do that when I’m supposed to be protecting you from {i}yourself.{/i}
lines.zh: : 我只是真的不知道该怎么做，当我要保护的对象是{i}你自己{/i}的时候。

lines.en: : You are not {i}supposed{/i} to be doing anything, my love.
lines.zh: : 你{i}本就{/i}不必做任何事，我的爱人。

lines.en: : This is a battle I must fight on my own. All you need to do is be there.
lines.zh: : 这是一场我必须独自面对的战斗。你只需要待在我身边就好。

lines.en: : What if I’m not, though? Like...what if I’m at work? This is already getting to me. I’ve barely been able to focus at all lately.
lines.zh: : 可如果我不在呢？比如……如果我在上班呢？这已经在折磨我了。我最近几乎完全没法集中精神。

lines.en: : I know.
lines.zh: : 我知道。

lines.en: : It must be hard.
lines.zh: : 一定很辛苦。

lines.en: : But it’s my fault you’re feeling this way. So it’s also my duty to make sure it does not continue to happen.
lines.zh: : 但你有这种感觉是我的错。所以确保它不再继续发生，也是我的责任。

lines.en: : Additionally, I was not implying that you need to physically “be there.” It was more of a “Have faith in me and I will persist,” sort of thing.
lines.zh: : 另外，我并不是说你需要肉体上“待在那里”。那更像是一种“相信我，我会撑下去”的意思。

lines.en: : That somehow sounds even harder.
lines.zh: : 听起来反而更难了。

lines.en: : It’s a challenge we will face together, then.
lines.zh: : 那么这就是我们要一起面对的挑战。

lines.en: : Just as staring at this ridiculous fucking tree has been a challenge for me.
lines.zh: : 就像盯着这棵荒唐透顶的树对我来说也是一种挑战一样。

lines.en: : You really hate it that much?
lines.zh: : 你真的那么讨厌它？

lines.en: : Why must it be so bright? And how did this strange, cultural tradition of covering a tree in lights even come to be? What significance do the lights even have? How does this relate to religion?
lines.zh: : 它为什么非得这么亮？还有，把一棵树缠满灯这种奇怪的文化传统到底是怎么来的？这些灯有什么意义？这跟宗教又有什么关系？

lines.en: : I think Christmas has kind of graduated being past a religious holiday for most of the cultures who actually celebrate it.
lines.zh: : 我觉得对大多数真正庆祝圣诞的文化来说，圣诞节早就超越了宗教节日的范畴。

lines.en: : Nonsense. Our tree is much better. And lasts two months longer as well.
lines.zh: : 胡说。我们家的树好多了。而且还能多摆两个月。

lines.en: : You only like our tree more because I let you cover it in lace.
lines.zh: : 你更喜欢我们家的树，只是因为我让你在上面挂满了蕾丝。

lines.en: : The only thing you will {i}not{/i} let me cover in lace is you.
lines.zh: : 唯一你{i}不{/i}让我挂满蕾丝的，就是你。

lines.en: : You know I’m not feminine enough to pull off the stuff you wear, Wakana. I’d just...feel like shit if I were to try.
lines.zh: : 你知道我没有那么女人味，撑不起你穿的那些东西，Wakana。我要是试了，只会……感觉很糟。

lines.en: : Oh well. It will do us no good simply standing around and discussing the things I would like to make you wear should you decide to catch up on confidence one day.
lines.zh: : 唉，好吧。光是站在这儿讨论“等你哪天自信起来我想让你穿什么”，对我们也没什么好处。

lines.en: : There are many more trees to see- and many more chances for me to remind you how happy I am to be both alive and by your side tonight.
lines.zh: : 还有更多树要看——也还有更多机会让我提醒你，今晚能活着、能在你身边，我有多开心。

lines.en: : Just try not to get lost, okay? I’m worrying enough as-is. I don’t want to have to deal with trying to find you in a crowd as well.
lines.zh: : 只是尽量别走丢了，好吗？我已经够操心的了。我可不想还得在人群里找你。

lines.en: : Yes, because I do not stand out enough with my appearance. I can see how easy it would be for you to lose sight of me.
lines.zh: : 是啊，就凭我这副样子还不够显眼。我明白你要弄丢我有多容易。

lines.en: : You know what I mean...
lines.zh: : 你知道我是什么意思……

lines.en: scene black
scene sidechristmas2
: I suppose that since you’re so worried about losing me, I’ll just have to hang on to you to make sure I don’t get lost.
lines.zh: : 既然你这么担心把我弄丢，那我就只能挂在你身上，好确保自己不会走丢。

lines.en: : Fine by me. Not like I’m going to complain about the prettiest girl here holding onto my arm.
lines.zh: : 我没意见。这里最漂亮的女孩挽着我的胳膊，我可没什么好抱怨的。

lines.en: : Don’t worry. I’m sure to make up for our quota of “things to complain about” for the rest of the night.
lines.zh: : 别担心。今晚剩下的“值得抱怨的事”配额，我肯定会替我们补上的。

lines.en: : Like that strange costume that man is wearing. What is that?
lines.zh: : 比如那个男人穿的那身奇怪的衣服。那是什么？

lines.en: : That would be Santa Claus, babe.
lines.zh: : 那是圣诞老人啊，宝贝。

lines.en: : Well he looks absolutely ridiculous and I have no idea why people are willingly bringing their children to him.
lines.zh: : 他看起来简直荒唐至极，我真不懂人们为什么还心甘情愿把孩子带到他跟前去。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas3
: Oh, Wakana. Do you need to take a break or anything?
lines.zh: : 哦，Wakana。你需要休息一下什么的吗？

lines.en: : We’ve been walking for a while now and I didn’t see you take any of your meds before we left home.
lines.zh: : 我们已经走了好一会儿了，而且出门前我没看见你吃药。

lines.en: : I’m fine for now, my kitten. I feel nothing at all.
lines.zh: : 我现在没事，我的小猫咪。我什么感觉都没有。

lines.en: : Perhaps it’s because I have such a strong arm supporting me?
lines.zh: : 也许是因为有你这么强壮的手臂撑着我？

lines.en: scene sidechristmas4
: Y-Yeah...maybe that’s it...
lines.zh: : 是、是啊……也许是吧……

lines.en: : If you need to stop, though, let me know. There are plenty of places to sit around here and...like I said...we’ve got the whole night...
lines.zh: : 不过你要是需要停下来，就跟我说。这附近有很多地方可以坐，而且……就像我说的……我们有一整个晚上……

lines.en: : And many more after it.
lines.zh: : 还有之后的很多个夜晚。

lines.en: : Merry Christmas, Osako.
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐，Osako。

lines.en: : Merry Christmas...Wakana...
lines.zh: : 圣诞快乐……Wakana……

lines.en: scene black
: Not every circular, ramen related item contains bumps and grooves, though.
lines.zh: : 不过，并非每一个圆形的、与拉面有关的物件都有凸起和沟槽。

lines.en: : And to discover that, you need not look any further than the container that holds the chashu.
lines.zh: : 要发现这一点，你不必看别处，看看装叉烧的容器就知道了。

lines.en: : Bowls come in all different colors and sizes, but they are unified in the fact that they are all circular.
lines.zh: : 碗有各种颜色和大小，但它们都有一个共同点——都是圆的。

lines.en: : Wait, Tsunecchi. My family had bowls that were kinda rectangular and-
lines.zh: : 等等，Tsunecchi。我家以前有种碗是长方形的，然后——

lines.en: : Heresy, Green Onion. Bowls are circular.
lines.zh: : 异端，青葱。碗就是圆的。

lines.en: : Your mana’s all tapped out and you can't play any more interrupts this turn. Proceed, Kendo Princess.
lines.zh: : 你的法力已经耗尽，这回合不能再打出任何打断牌了。继续，剑道公主。

lines.en: : Thank you, Emerald Guardian.
lines.zh: : 谢谢你，翡翠守护者。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas5
: As I was saying, sometimes the bumps and grooves of chashu become less noticeable when you stop focusing on that one aspect and look at the bowl instead. Or, in this case, the big picture.
lines.zh: : 我刚才说到，有时候当你不再盯着叉烧的某一个特征看，而是去看那只碗——或者在这个情况下，去看全局——那些凸起和沟槽就没那么明显了。

lines.en: : Oh, is {i}that{/i} what you were saying? I was having a hard time following.
lines.zh: : 哦，你刚才说的是{i}这个{/i}意思？我有点跟不上。

lines.en: : Silence please, affluent woman.
lines.zh: : 请安静，富贵女人。

lines.en: : Sometimes, the troubles and imperfections of life itself are harder to spot than they would be with seared pork.
lines.zh: : 有时候，生活本身的烦恼和不完美，比叉烧上的那些更难被发现。

lines.en: : You could have a beautiful looking bowl that seems immaculate to the untrained eye when filled with ramen-
lines.zh: : 你可能有一只看起来很美的碗，盛满拉面时在不专业的眼里完美无瑕——

lines.en: : But underneath the broth could be cracks- splintering out as if they were a spiderweb.
lines.zh: : 但汤汁底下可能有裂缝——像蜘蛛网一样向外裂开。

lines.en: : And all there is to do is keep refilling it in hopes that the cracks do not become too much to bear.
lines.zh: : 而你唯一能做的就是不断把它重新填满，希望那些裂缝别大到无法承受。

lines.en: : Kaori...can you stop annoying customers and help me out for a second? I’ve got no fuckin’ idea where the corkscrew is and we’ve got a table in the back looking for a bottle of wine.
lines.zh: : Kaori……你能别再烦客人了，过来帮我一下吗？我完全他妈的不知道开瓶器在哪儿，后面那桌还等着一瓶葡萄酒。

lines.en: : No, no, no! You’re all wrong! That’s not the best way to rub a cock at all!
lines.zh: : 不，不，不！你们全错了！那根本不是撸鸡巴的最好方法！

lines.en: : Listen here, temporary bartender girl. I’m about to teach you a trick that will drive your boyfriend wild.
lines.zh: : 听着，临时酒保小姐。我要教你一招，能让你男朋友爽到发疯。

lines.en: : First, straighten out your palm and-
lines.zh: : 首先，把手掌伸直，然后——

lines.en: : Wait! I am not talking about the human cock! I am talking about the chicken cock! I have learned the difference recently!
lines.zh: : 等等！我不是在说人类的鸡巴！我说的是公鸡的鸡巴！我最近才学会区分的！

lines.en: scene sidechristmas6
: The...
lines.zh: : 那个……

lines.en: : Wait, is that even legal? Am I allowed to talk about this?
lines.zh: : 等等，这合法吗？我能说这个吗？

lines.en: : Uhh...I’m gonna hope this is just another misunderstanding and ask you again for a little help, please?
lines.zh: : 呃……我就当这又是一场误会，再求你帮我一次，行吗？

lines.en: : Not much time to fuck around tonight, unfortunately. Whether it be with...chicken or human.
lines.zh: : 今晚可惜没多少时间瞎混。不管是……跟鸡还是跟人。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas7
: The swirly metal fermented grape blood opener can be found inside the moving wooden rectangle closest to the back of your head, Aunt Yukiburger!
lines.zh: : 那个螺旋形的金属发酵葡萄血开启器，就在你后脑勺最近的那个会动的木头长方形里面，Yukiburger 阿姨！

lines.en: : The...swirly metal...grape blood...rectangle...
lines.zh: : 那个……螺旋形的金属……葡萄血……长方形……

lines.en: : Okay. Got it. I’ll just-
lines.zh: : 好。明白了。我就——

lines.en: : Wait, if you knew what I was talking about when I asked for the corkscrew, why’d you call it that weird shit? Use the right words for shit if you know ‘em, Kaori. You’re gonna confuse somebody.
lines.zh: : 等等，既然我问开瓶器的时候你知道我在说什么，那你干嘛叫它那种怪东西？知道就好好说人话，Kaori。你会把人搞糊涂的。

lines.en: : Girl you’re servin’ already looks like she’s havin’ an existential crisis.
lines.zh: : 你在招待的那个姑娘看起来已经陷入存在主义危机了。

lines.en: : Should I be stocking up on chicken porn? Is that really what people are into nowadays?
lines.zh: : 我是不是该囤点鸡肉色情片？现在的人真的好这口吗？

lines.en: scene sidechristmas8
: I can’t believe it! Haru-chan! People are actually in my bar!
lines.zh: : 我真不敢相信！Haru-chan！我的酒吧里真的有人！

lines.en: : People are spending money at my bar! They are talking to each other at my bar!
lines.zh: : 有人在我的酒吧里花钱！他们在我的酒吧里互相聊天！

lines.en: : Yup. Those are the things you’re supposed to do at a bar.
lines.zh: : 对。这些就是你在酒吧里该做的事。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas9
: Hey! Just because you’re a successful business owner doesn’t mean you should be acting like this isn’t a big deal for me.
lines.zh: : 嘿！就算你是个成功的老板，也不该表现得好像这对我来说不是什么大事一样。

lines.en: : Pretty soon, I’m going to be joining both you {i}and{/i} Maki in the list of people we know who are actually doing pretty well for themselves.
lines.zh: : 很快，我就要加入你{i}和{/i} Maki 的行列，成为我们认识的、日子过得相当不错的人之一了。

lines.en: : I just have to figure out how to bring people in on, like...{i}not{/i} holidays anymore and I’ll be set.
lines.zh: : 我只需要想明白怎么在，怎么说……{i}不是{/i}节假日的日子里也把人招进来，那就稳了。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas10
: Well, all things considered, things have been pretty great tonight.
lines.zh: : 嗯，总的来说，今晚一切都挺棒的。

lines.en: : And the bar looks awesome, too.
lines.zh: : 而且酒吧看起来也很赞。

lines.en: : Well, you {i}did{/i} help set the place up, so I can’t take {i}all{/i} of the credit for that.
lines.zh: : 嗯，布置这地方你{i}也有{/i}帮忙，所以这功劳我不能{i}全{/i}揽。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas11
: Uhh...{i}about{/i} that...
lines.zh: : 呃……{i}关于{/i}那件事……

lines.en: : I...didn’t really have any idea that...anything like {i}that{/i} was going to happen today, so...
lines.zh: : 我……真的完全没想到今天会发生……{i}那种{/i}事，所以……

lines.en: : Well, it’s not like I was really planning on it?
lines.zh: : 怎么说呢，我也没真的计划过？

lines.en: : If anything {i}did{/i} happen, I figured you were just going to wait downstairs...
lines.zh: : 如果{i}真{/i}会发生什么，我以为你会在楼下等着……

lines.en: : Yeah, well...you kind of egged me on, so...
lines.zh: : 是啊，不过……你也有点怂恿我来着，所以……

lines.en: : Yeah...I didn’t really think about what I was saying until after the fact...but...uhh...
lines.zh: : 是……我说话的时候真没过脑子，事后再想……不过……呃……

lines.en: scene sidechristmas12
: I’m sorry!
lines.zh: : 对不起！

lines.en: scene sidechristmas13
: I said a lot worse stuff than you, so let me apologize first.
lines.zh: : 我说的话可比你难听多了，所以让我先道歉。

lines.en: : It’s true that I got pissed off by all of the teasing when my husband’s been gone for so long...but I guess I kind of forgot that yours was too.
lines.zh: : 我丈夫走了这么久，我被那些调侃惹毛了，这是事实……不过我大概是忘了，你丈夫也不在。

lines.en: : You’re just always so all over Sensei that I forget we’re one and the same sometimes.
lines.zh: : 你总是那么黏着老师，我有时候都忘了我们其实是一路人。

lines.en: : So...that kinda fueled some of the stuff I said while things were happening and...it got a little too out of control.
lines.zh: : 所以……这多少助长了事情发生时我说的那些话，然后……就有点失控了。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas14
: Are you, like...{i}into{/i} that kind of stuff, Haruka?
lines.zh: : 你是，怎么说……{i}好那一口{/i}吗，Haruka？

lines.en: : The...shaming and...whatnot?
lines.zh: : 就是……羞辱什么的……那类？

lines.en: : Because it seemed like it was more than just anger or jealousy. It seemed like you were actually...{i}enjoying{/i} it.
lines.zh: : 因为看起来那不只是愤怒或嫉妒。看起来你是真的……{i}乐在其中{/i}。

lines.en: : I guess that...makes it a lot worse, huh?
lines.zh: : 我想……这让事情变得更糟了吧？

lines.en: scene sidechristmas15
: I mean...not really?...
lines.zh: : 我是说……也不一定？……

lines.en: : Like, it’s one thing if you were saying all of that stuff just to hurt me, but...if it was just so you could have a little more fun...we can just...forget it ever happened.
lines.zh: : 就是说，如果你说那些话只是为了伤我，那是一回事，但……如果你只是想让自己更尽兴一点……那我们就……当它从没发生过。

lines.en: : That’s fine. I’m sorry again. I said some really fucked up shit that sounded hot at the time, but...fuck, I felt so bad when I went home that I actually cried.
lines.zh: : 没关系。再说一次对不起。我说了些他妈的很过分的话，当时听着很带感，但……操，我回家之后难受得真的哭了。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas16
: Well at least {i}you{/i} didn’t cry while there was a penis inside of you.
lines.zh: : 至少{i}你{/i}没有在有鸡巴插在你里面的时候哭。

lines.en: : Hahah...hah...yeah...
lines.zh: : 哈哈哈……哈……是啊……

lines.en: scene sidechristmas17
: That was...certainly an experience, though.
lines.zh: : 不过那……确实是段经历。

lines.en: : I had no idea that my first threesome would be so...vulgar and hurtful.
lines.zh: : 我完全没想到我的第一次三人行会这么……粗俗又伤人。

lines.en: : Did that like, even {i}really{/i} count as a threesome, though? Because I was kind of just there watching. I wasn’t {i}actually{/i} involved.
lines.zh: : 不过那{i}真的{/i}算三人行吗？因为我基本就是在一旁看着。我并没有{i}真的{/i}参与。

lines.en: : I think it counts. Even if you just watched, you definitely...uhh...participated? Like, it would have been a completely different experience without you.
lines.zh: : 我觉得算。就算你只是看着，你也确实……呃……参与了？就是说，如果没有你，那会是完全不同的一段体验。

lines.en: : I guess so.
lines.zh: : 大概是吧。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas18
: Definitely an interesting way to start Christmas, though.
lines.zh: : 不过这确实是开启圣诞节的别致方式。

lines.en: : Can’t say I expected to watch my best friend get railed like an hour after helping her choose which color of tinsel to use.
lines.zh: : 我可没想过，帮闺蜜挑完该用哪种颜色的金属丝之后不到一小时，就能看着她被人干。

lines.en: : And I can’t say I expected mine to enjoy it so much.
lines.zh: : 而我也没想过我发现自己会这么享受。

lines.en: : Also, did I sound weird? And don’t say you didn’t hear it this time since you were literally right there.
lines.zh: : 还有，我听起来怪吗？这次别说你没听见，你当时可是就在旁边。

lines.en: : I don’t remember. I was too busy being hurtful and perverted.
lines.zh: : 我不记得了。我当时正忙着又伤人又变态呢。

lines.en: : Ugh. Please pay more attention next time because I really need to know and I don’t want to record myself.
lines.zh: : 呃。下次请多留点神，因为我真的想知道，我又不想录自己。

lines.en: : You know, I really didn’t expect there to be a next time.
lines.zh: : 你知道吗，我真没想到还会有下次。

lines.en: : Me neither, but...we’re mature adults. I think we can do it again without all of the...meanness next time.
lines.zh: : 我也是，不过……我们是成熟的成年人。我觉得下次可以再来，只是别带上所有那些……刻薄。

lines.en: : So, uhh...the bar.
lines.zh: : 那么，呃……酒吧的事。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas19
: Right! The bar!
lines.zh: : 对！酒吧！

lines.en: : It looks so good. And we’ve got three whole employees working tonight.
lines.zh: : 看起来太棒了。而且今晚有整整三个员工在干活。

lines.en: : I wish Sana could have been here as well, but her Christmas party just had to be on like, the single least convenient day of all time.
lines.zh: : 我真希望 Sana 也能来，但她的圣诞派对偏偏挑了有史以来最不方便的一天。

lines.en: : You mean...Christmas?
lines.zh: : 你是说……圣诞节？

lines.en: : Shut up.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas20
: Wait, Kaori...
lines.zh: : 等等，Kaori……

lines.en: : Yes, Aunt Yukiburger? Do you need help finding another shiny item in this labyrinth of intoxicated women?
lines.zh: : 怎么了，Yukiburger 阿姨？你需要我帮你在这座醉醺醺的女人迷宫里再找一件闪闪发亮的东西吗？

lines.en: : No, it’s just...
lines.zh: : 不，只是……

lines.en: : I could be completely misremembering but like, ain’t it your birthday today?
lines.zh: : 我可能记错了，不过，今天是不是你生日啊？

lines.en: scene sidechristmas21
: But I have so many memories of other days! How could I have been born today?!
lines.zh: : 可我拥有那么多其他日子的记忆！我怎么可能是今天出生的？！

lines.en: : No, it means like...you were born on a different “today” in the past.
lines.zh: : 不，意思是……你出生在过去某个不同的“今天”。

lines.en: : I am from the past?!
lines.zh: : 我来自过去？！

lines.en: : I mean...we kinda all are.
lines.zh: : 我是说……我们多少都是吧。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas22
: Kaori, is that true? Is it really your birthday today?
lines.zh: : Kaori，是真的吗？今天真的是你生日？

lines.en: : I still do not understand the concept of this “day of birthing,” but if Aunt Yukiburger, who is also from the past, knows the past-version of me...it might be true!
lines.zh: : 我仍然不理解“生日”这个概念，但如果同样来自过去的 Yukiburger 阿姨认识过去版本的我……那可能是真的！

lines.en: : Will something bad happen as a result of this? Has my time here finally come to an end?
lines.zh: : 这会招来什么坏事吗？我在这里的时间终于要走到尽头了吗？

lines.en: : I must say goodbye to John!
lines.zh: : 我必须和 John 道别！

lines.en: : Is John your chicken boyfriend?
lines.zh: : John 是你的鸡男朋友吗？

lines.en: : Just her chicken. And he’s fucking huge, too. You should see that thing.
lines.zh: : 就是她的鸡。而且那玩意儿他妈的大得要命。你真该看看。

lines.en: scene sidechristmas23
: Heh. Huge cock.
lines.zh: : 嘿。好大的鸡巴。

lines.en: : Haru-chan, you didn’t see any birthday decorations in the storage room, did you?
lines.zh: : Haru-chan，你在储藏室里看到生日装饰了吗？

lines.en: : Hm? I might have seen like, a banner or something. But are you really sure you want to put something like that up while we already have all of the Christmas decorations out?
lines.zh: : 嗯？我好像看到一条横幅什么的。不过你确定要在圣诞装饰都挂出来的时候再挂那个吗？

lines.en: scene sidechristmas24
: Kaori, are you going straight home after we close tonight?
lines.zh: : Kaori，今晚打烊后你会直接回家吗？

lines.en: : Sleeping at work is forbidden, so I normally go home at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 在工作场所睡觉是被禁止的，所以我一般在一天结束时回家。

lines.en: : Stay later tonight. After all of the customers leave, we’ll throw a little birthday party for you.
lines.zh: : 今晚晚点再走。等客人都走了，我们给你办个小生日派对。

lines.en: : Ooooh, fun! I haven’t pulled an all-nighter in years. What better reason to break that streak than for a temporary bartender’s birthday party?
lines.zh: : 哦哦哦，好玩！我已经好多年没通宵了。有什么比为了一个临时酒保的生日派对打破这个纪录更好的理由呢？

lines.en: scene sidechristmas25
: A party? For me? Just because I was born?
lines.zh: : 派对？为我办的？就因为我出生了？

lines.en: : Is that really a cause for celebration?
lines.zh: : 这真的值得庆祝吗？

lines.en: : Of course it is! Be happy you’re alive!
lines.zh: : 当然值得！为你还活着而高兴吧！

lines.en: : I feel shitty for not gettin’ you somethin’ now. Can’t believe I forgot.
lines.zh: : 没给你准备东西，我现在心里挺过意不去的。不敢相信我居然忘了。

lines.en: : Not a big fan of stayin’ awake through the night, but I’ll make an exception for you since we’re related and shit.
lines.zh: : 我可不是特别喜欢熬夜，不过看在我们是亲戚什么的份上，我为你破个例。

lines.en: : I do not understand the customs that typically accompany human birth-parties, but since I am the subject of the tradition this time, I will remain inside and do as you instruct.
lines.zh: : 我不理解人类的生日派对通常伴随的习俗，不过既然这次我是这个传统的对象，那我就留在屋里，照你们说的做。

lines.en: : Woo-hoo! It’s settled, then! Haruka, go get the banner!
lines.zh: : 哇哦！那就这么定了！Haruka，去拿横幅！

lines.en: : Sara, I think you’re forgetting that I don’t actually work here. I’m a customer right now.
lines.zh: : Sara，我想你忘了我其实不在这儿工作。我现在是顾客。

lines.en: : Maki, banner!
lines.zh: : Maki，横幅！

lines.en: : Are you just going to ask {i}everyone{/i} who doesn’t work here?
lines.zh: : 你这是打算问遍{i}所有{/i}不在这儿工作的人吗？

lines.en: scene black
: You there! What’s your name?
lines.zh: : 那边那个！你叫什么名字？

lines.en: : Me?
: Yes! Who are you?
lines.zh: : 对！你是谁？

lines.en: : Matthew.
lines.zh: : Matthew。

lines.en: : Take this key, open that door over there, pull out the birthday banner, and your next drink is on me.
lines.zh: : 拿着这把钥匙，打开那边那扇门，把生日横幅拿出来，你的下一杯我请。

lines.en: : Oh. Uhh...okay. I’m on it.
lines.zh: : 哦。呃……好的。我这就去。

lines.en: : Wonderful! Thanks, Matthew.
lines.zh: : 太好了！谢了，Matthew。
